2. Eligibility

The website and Decipher’s investment-related services are intended only for persons who are at least 18 years of age.

By using the website, you represent that you are at least 18 years old.

If you use the website on behalf of a company, institution, family office, partnership, fund or other organisation, you represent that you have authority to act on behalf of that organisation in connection with the relevant interaction.

3. Purpose of the Website

The website provides general information about Decipher, its business, capabilities and services and allows prospective investors, founders, companies, institutions and other persons to contact us.

The public website is currently intended principally as an informational and enquiry platform.

Accessing the website, reading its content or submitting an enquiry does not by itself:

  • create an investment-advisory relationship;
  • create a fiduciary relationship;
  • establish a client relationship;
  • constitute acceptance of an investment mandate;
  • create an obligation for Decipher to provide services;
  • constitute an offer or commitment by Decipher to arrange any investment or transaction; or
  • guarantee that you will be eligible to participate in any opportunity.

Any formal service, advisory, investment, transaction or engagement relationship may be subject to separate documentation, eligibility requirements, regulatory requirements and written terms.

4. Website Information

Information available on the public website is provided for general informational purposes.

Website content may include information regarding:

  • Decipher’s business and services;
  • capital-raising and investment-related activities;
  • private-market, secondary or pre-IPO markets;
  • founders, companies and investors;
  • general investment-market concepts; and
  • other business or financial topics.

Unless expressly stated in a separately applicable written engagement, general website content should not be treated as personalized advice directed to your particular financial circumstances.

Any individualized recommendation, advisory interaction or transaction-related service must be considered in the context of the specific communication, engagement and applicable regulatory requirements.

5. No Offer Through General Website Content

Unless expressly stated otherwise in specific authorized documentation, general information displayed publicly on the website does not itself constitute:

  • an offer to issue, purchase or sell securities;
  • an invitation to subscribe for securities;
  • a commitment to arrange a securities transaction;
  • an offer of units in a fund, SPV or investment vehicle;
  • a guarantee of allocation;
  • a guarantee of listing;
  • a guarantee of liquidity; or
  • a guarantee of any investment outcome.

Any investment opportunity communicated separately by Decipher may be subject to its own documentation, eligibility requirements, issuer or seller terms, regulatory conditions, risk disclosures and transaction process.

6. Investment and Securities Risks

Investments in securities and other financial or investment products involve risk.

Depending on the relevant instrument and transaction, risks may include:

  • loss of some or all invested capital;
  • price volatility;
  • absence of liquidity;
  • difficulty finding a buyer;
  • delays or failure in an anticipated listing or exit;
  • issuer or counterparty risk;
  • business and financial-performance risk;
  • regulatory and legal risk;
  • valuation uncertainty;
  • dilution;
  • market conditions; and
  • risks specific to private, unlisted, pre-IPO or early-stage securities.

An indication that a company may pursue an IPO, listing, financing, acquisition or other liquidity event is not a guarantee that the event will occur or occur within any particular timeframe.

No return, valuation, exit, listing, liquidity or investment result is guaranteed merely because an opportunity is discussed by Decipher.

7. Investment Decisions

You remain responsible for understanding the terms and risks of any transaction in which you participate.

Before entering into an investment or transaction, you should carefully review the applicable transaction documents, issuer information, risk disclosures and other relevant material.

Where appropriate, you should obtain professional advice concerning matters such as legal, tax, accounting and other consequences relevant to your circumstances.

Nothing in these Terms is intended to override any duty or responsibility that applies to Decipher under an applicable law, regulation or separately executed engagement.

8. No Custody Through the Website

The public website is not designed as a custody platform or securities account.

Submitting an enquiry through the website does not itself transfer money, securities or ownership interests to Decipher.

Where an investment transaction proceeds, the applicable payment, settlement, transfer and custody arrangements will depend on the particular transaction and its governing documentation.

9. Enquiries and Information You Submit

The website may allow you to provide information including:

  • name;
  • email address;
  • phone number;
  • company or organisation;
  • designation;
  • investor type;
  • indicative investment amount;
  • city;
  • country;
  • message content; and
  • other information you voluntarily provide.

You agree that information you submit through the website will, to the best of your knowledge, be accurate and not intentionally misleading.

You must not submit information that:

  • you are not authorized to disclose;
  • unlawfully infringes another person’s rights;
  • contains malicious code;

  • violates applicable law; or

You grant Decipher the limited right to use information you submit as reasonably necessary to review and respond to your enquiry, communicate with you, evaluate a potential engagement and carry out activities described in our Privacy Policy.

Our handling of personal information is governed by our Privacy Policy.

You may communicate with Decipher through channels including email and WhatsApp.

You may ask us to stop such communications at any time by:

Electronic communications can be subject to delays, interception, technical errors, delivery failures or security risks. You should use appropriate care when communicating confidential information electronically.

We aim to maintain a useful and accessible website, but we do not guarantee that the website will always be available, uninterrupted or error-free.

You should not rely on outdated website information where current information is material to a decision.

Where information concerning a specific transaction differs from current authorized transaction documentation, the applicable transaction documentation should be reviewed as the primary source for that transaction.
